items.summary: Recommendation: do not expand monetization, marketing, or AI-intensive production work this cycle. Retain only bounded report-only measurement and control work. The 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-23 AI usage report shows $775.70 across 4,611 calls and 39 instrumented sites, while Amazon data covers only 2026-09-21 and reports $4.92 commission, all in an unattributed aggregate row. These periods and attribution scopes do not support contribution margin, ROI, payback, CAC, or revenue forecasts. Existing SEO impressions, clicks, sessions, and conversions are leading indicators, not revenue evidence. No budget, infrastructure spend, labor cost, or fixed-cost schedule is supplied, so total margin and budget exposure are uncalculable. Keep the current private launch gate and existing measurement windows unchanged; do not add the proposed CRO experiments until attributable revenue and cost baselines are available.
